system_state_snapshot.recent_sales_summary: Aucune vente. Le systeme est en phase de mise en place des moteurs de production.
open_issues: Generation d'image: HF ne sert plus FLUX/SDXL gratuitement, Gemini image = 429 (payant), AI Horde bloque depuis les IP GitHub Actions (403). Seul Pollinations repond mais qualite brute.
Pistes image en cours: Together AI (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + img2img) et Cloudflare Workers AI (gratuit 10k neurons/j) a tester; Runware en PAYG plafonne 20€ comme option qualite/volume.
Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.name: Geotechnical Engineers & Soil Mechanics Professionals
proposals.buyer_persona: Civil engineers, geologists, and soil mechanics researchers who love obscure technical humor, Mohr's circle formulas, and soil classification systems. They are proud of their highly specialized, dirt-focused niche.
product_angles: Mohr's Circle stress-strain diagram minimalist apparel and desk mats
USCS (Unified Soil Classification System) reference cheat-sheet stickers
Humorous 'Not afraid to get dirty' technical engineering mugs and hoodies
proposals.first_test_product: Minimalist 'Mohr's Circle of Stress' vector graphic for Redbubble/Etsy t-shirts and mugs

proposals.name: Print-and-Play (PnP) Solo Board Gamers
proposals.buyer_persona: Solo gamers who enjoy printing, cutting, and assembling their own tabletop games. They look for high-quality, ink-saving components, modular hex cards, and pocket-sized deck systems.
product_angles: Pocket-sized micro-game layout templates (9-card design frameworks)
3D printable custom miniature/token counters optimized for low-cost FDM printing
proposals.first_test_product: A modular 18-card PNP fantasy crawler tile-set layout template (PDF on Etsy)

proposals.name: Local Micro-Museums and Historical Societies
proposals.buyer_persona: Volunteers and curators of small-town local museums, castles, or preservation societies. They have zero budget for design agencies but need high-quality custom souvenirs for their gift shops.
product_angles: Hyper-local customized coloring books featuring local historical monuments (using img2img line extraction)
Vector-restored vintage local maps packaged as high-res poster prints
Custom SVG historical architecture silhouettes for local merchandise
proposals.first_test_product: A 15-page localized historical monuments coloring book template to pitch directly to French regional tourist offices via email

proposals.name: Urban Sketchers & Plein Air Painters
proposals.buyer_persona: Artists who travel and draw on-site in cities. They obsess over lightweight gear, compact watercolor setups, and specialized paper grids for perspective sketching.
product_angles: Perspective-grid pocket notebooks (1-point, 2-point, and 3-point faint layouts) on KDP
Minimalist pocket viewfinders and composition cards (SVG templates for laser cutting or 3D printing)
proposals.first_test_product: A 3D-printable magnetic travel watercolor palette holding 6 half-pans (Cults3D)

proposals.name: Godot 4 UI/UX Indie Game Developers
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie developers migrating to Godot 4 who struggle with creating aesthetic, functional user interfaces. They want drag-and-drop themes, modular SVGs, and vector buttons.
product_angles: Retro-futuristic / Sci-Fi vector UI asset packs (SVGs optimized for Godot 9-patch scaling)
Minimalist dark-mode UI theme presets and icon fonts
Custom stylized vector crosshairs, health bars, and status icons
proposals.first_test_product: A clean, vector-based Flat Cyberpunk UI asset pack (buttons, panels, icons) in SVG format on Etsy/Itch.io

proposals.name: Amateur Radio (HAM) Operators & DXers
proposals.buyer_persona: Tech-savvy hobbyists who communicate globally via radio waves. They are deeply proud of their callsigns, love physical logbooks, and trade custom-designed QSL cards globally.
product_angles: Customizable QSL card templates (Etsy digital downloads)
Radio logbook journals with highly optimized layouts for signal reporting (KDP)
Radio spectrum frequency allocation posters and desk mats
proposals.first_test_product: A highly functional HAM Radio Logbook with detailed fields for frequency, mode, power, and QSL tracking (KDP)
